effects: The signer sends `amount` FXRP (6 decimals) from their own balance to `to`. There is no fee, burn or tax: OZ ERC20._transfer moves the full amount.
The balance history checkpoints of the signer and of `to` are updated. This is bookkeeping only and moves no asset.
No native value moves: transfer is nonpayable, so a call with value reverts.
formats.shown: "Send FXRP", with the amount in FXRP (6 decimals) and the recipient address.

findings.title: transfer limits the `To` address types to eoa and wallet, but the code accepts any recipient, contracts included.
findings.evidence: descriptor transfer field To: "types": ["eoa","wallet"]; ERC20._transfer only requires `to != address(0)` and FAsset._beforeTokenTransfer requires `_from != _to`.

cases.notes: Synthetic case with no mined tx. Judged from the code: 1 FXRP (1000000 raw, 6 decimals) goes to the recipient, and the screen shows exactly that.

effects: The signer sets the allowance of `spender` over their FXRP to exactly `amount`. This replaces any earlier allowance.
No token moves and no native value moves: approve is nonpayable.
formats.shown: "Approve FXRP", with the spender and the amount in FXRP. An amount of 2^255 or more shows as "Unlimited".

cases.notes: Synthetic case, no mined tx. Sets a 10 FXRP allowance for AssetManager. The screen shows the spender and 10 FXRP.
Synthetic case, no mined tx. Sets a 2^255 allowance. The screen shows "Unlimited FXRP", which follows the registry convention.
